title: Avian Architecture Revised and Expanded Edition: How Birds Design, Engineer, and Build
content: Avian Architecture Revised and Expanded Edition: How Birds Design, Engineer, and Build by GoodfellowPeter. 2024. Princeton University Press. Princeton, New Jersey. 176 pp., 300+ color illustrations. $29.95 (hardcover). ISBN 978-0-691-25546-0.
